verdict.rationale: Mastra documents structured output, where an agent returns an object matching a schema instead of text. That covers the schema-validated half of the story. Nothing in the evidence shows automatic retries or re-prompting when validation fails; the generic processor note about validating messages is adjacent and earns no credit. missing for 10: documented automatic retry on schema-validation failure, details of how validation is enforced (e.g., Zod schemas, error handling), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get schema-validated structured output from an agent, with automatic retries when validation fails

citations.quote: Structured output lets an agent return an object that matches the shape defined by a schema instead of returning text.
